hook: Your view of Saturn's north pole shows a giant six-sided cloud.
title: Saturn Has A Hexagon Wider Than Earth
description:
Saturn's north pole has a six-sided pattern of clouds. It is a jet stream, and NASA's Cassini spacecraft photographed it. The hexagon is wider than planet Earth.

#Shorts #Space #Saturn
comment_prompt: Real or fake at first glance? Pick one

scenes.narration: Saturn's north pole has six straight sides.
scenes.headline: SIX-SIDED CLOUD

scenes.narration: It is a giant hexagon of clouds.
scenes.headline: A GIANT HEXAGON

scenes.narration: The Cassini spacecraft photographed it up close.
scenes.headline: PHOTOGRAPHED BY CASSINI

scenes.narration: It is a jet stream circling the pole.
scenes.headline: A JET STREAM

scenes.narration: The hexagon is wider than Earth.
scenes.headline: WIDER THAN EARTH

scenes.narration: Our whole planet could fit inside it.
scenes.headline: EARTH FITS INSIDE

scenes.narration: Nobody built it. It is weather.
scenes.headline: JUST WEATHER

scenes.narration: Weather that draws straight lines in space.
scenes.headline: STRAIGHT-LINE STORM

scenes.narration: Saturn's pole really is a hexagon.
scenes.headline: A REAL HEXAGON
